newsitem.title: FRANCE: French woman accused of harassing Paco Rabanne.
newsitem.headline: French woman accused of harassing Paco Rabanne.

text.p: Prosecutors on Monday sought a suspended one-year jail sentence for a woman accused of harassing French fashion designer Paco Rabanne, who she claims has Satanic powers.

Rabanne, who is 62 and has written several books on the supernatural, told the court that Josianne Pasquier, 51, regularly followed him to lunch at his favourite restaurant, shouting "Satan! Pimp! Paedophile!" or accusing him of having raped her daughter.
He said she also often went to his boutique, trying to dissuade clients from entering "Satan's den."
Pasquier told a perplexed courtroom that Rabanne, best-known for futuristic designs featuring metal mini-skirts and tubes, spoke to her via telepathy.
"Every time I eat chocolate, he tells me I eat too much and I tell him that I am not homosexual," she said.
The court will give its ruling on February 24.
